instruction: Put the cube in the green square and let go (either arm, any embodiment).

outcome.real_measurement: Cube centre inside the target square at every judged step: min(half - |dx|, half - |dy|) >= 0 (target frame axis-aligned). Real world: top camera, cube centre vs the marked square.
Resting on the table: lowest point of the cube within 5 mm of the table top at every judged step (a held or perched cube is higher). Real world: RGB-D cube pose vs the table plane.
Settled: cube speed <= 2 cm/s at every judged step. Real world: frame differencing of the tracked pose.
Stays put: cube centre moves <= 2 mm over the judged window. Real world: tracked pose, 1 s.

Consequence test after the judged window: every arm whose gripper / hand is within 3 cm of the cube retracts its TCP 3 cm along its approach axis in 0.5 s with its last gripper command unchanged, then holds 0.5 s; the cube centre must move <= 1 cm during this aftermath. Real world: same motion on the robot, tracked cube pose (top camera / RGB-D).

counterexamples.name: scripted_place
counterexamples.description: positive control: mplib pick-and-place, gripper/hand opened, arm retreats

counterexamples.name: hold_without_release
counterexamples.description: cube carried into the square and set down, gripper/hand stays closed on it

counterexamples.description: cube set down, gripper opened only ~1 mm beyond the cube width: no contact but still enclosed

source.protocol: v3 (veritask/adapters/protocol_v3.py, unchanged) + imsim v3.1 additions (imsim/imsim/verify/v31.py): enclosure over all gripper / hand links, evaluator-run retreat aftermath
source.frozen: E23, 2026-11-15, written and hashed before any v3.1 evaluation run; the two changes are the fixes proposed in E19_REPORT.md section 5; all other constants copied from v3 without tuning

notes: v3.1 = v3 with two changes. (1) Release: the enclosure signal is cube_enclosure_all_m (imsim.verify.v31.EnclosureAll) = min of v3's finger-side rule and an all-link rule: every collision-hull point of every gripper link (all links below the flange plus grasp_links; hands: every hand link incl. the palm) is split at the cube centre along the closing axis; points inside the cube's lateral shadow (+2 mm) on both sides = enclosed, clearance = sum of the two sides' box distances; hands: centre inside the hull of all hand links, clearance = thumb + min(finger, palm). Same 2 mm margin as v3. (2) Consequence term aftermath.retreat_object_disp: after the judged window the evaluator retracts every arm near the cube (gripper within near_m) by retreat_m along -z of its TCP (approach axis) over retreat_s, last gripper command unchanged, holds hold_s, and measures the largest cube-centre displacement; the judged traces are restored afterwards (aftermath saved as 'aft:' keys). A missing aftermath (retreat not plannable) makes the verdict unknown. Everything else (signals, settle with hold A, quiescence, window, outcome terms 1-4) is identical to v3.
